hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: Initially flashed NOR root image
inputs.revision: Original 10 MiB LittleFS root image; ordinary POWER boot selected kernel #33 and mounted the writable filesystem from flash1. The hash identifies the original image artifact, not the subsequently modified partition.

inputs.name: Local syslog service configuration fix
inputs.revision: EmberBSD e3cdbd27215d; supplies the local logging configuration fix.

scenario: On one reported V1.2 sample, perform an ordinary POWER boot from NOR, connect using Ed25519 key-only SSH with strict host-key checking, exercise PTY and read-only dmesg, and transfer/read back small and 510196-byte files. Check WPA/IP after transfer. Start local syslogd with -s on the running root and read back a unique logger message.
expected: The bounded SSH session and byte comparisons succeed; WPA and IPv4 remain available after transfer; local syslog records the unique message.
observed: Kernel #33 booted normally from NOR with LittleFS root on flash1. Pinned-host-key Ed25519 SSH succeeded, including PTY, dmesg read, a small-file byte readback, and a 510196-byte utility transfer through ssh/cat with byte verification. The utility reported TX completion and exited 0; peer ACK was not confirmed. The temporary file was removed. WPA remained COMPLETED with SAE and PMF=1 and IPv4 remained present after transfer. syslogd initially failed because generated rc.conf omitted the default -s flag; syslogd_flags="-s" was added to rc.conf in the installed NOR filesystem and the existing service started. A unique logger message was read from /var/log/messages. After one service restart of mdnsd while WPA and IPv4 were already active, a direct host mDNS A query returned the target's correct IPv4; lookup at initial startup had not answered. The original root image artifact was not rebuilt or reflashed.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and one bounded run; repeated-session reliability and other revisions are not established.

The syslog -s setting was persisted in rc.conf on the installed NOR filesystem. The original root image artifact was not rebuilt or reflashed; its recorded SHA-256 does not describe the modified partition contents.

A direct host mDNS A query resolved the name to the correct IPv4 only after one mdnsd restart with WPA/IPv4 already active. This is not cold-start acceptance, does not establish automatic resolution after initial boot, and does not isolate a single cause.
SFTP was not selected; file transfer used SSH and cat.
TX completion is not peer acknowledgement, receiver acceptance, or successful Action-frame delivery; no RRM/BTM acceptance is established.
Private logs, credentials, host keys, network identifiers and binary images are not published.
